description_text:
## Job Description

In this role, your primary focus will be proactive telesales, lead nurturing, and rigorous qualification. You will not be responsible for closing deals; instead, your mission is to ensure that our Account Executives/Sales Team only spend their time speaking with highly qualified, sales-ready prospects. Rigorous Qualification: Vet prospects using established criteria (e.g., BANT: Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) to ensure they are a perfect fit for our solution before passing them on. Seamless Handoffs: Schedule meetings and product demonstrations for the senior sales team, providing them with detailed background notes and prospect pain points. CRM Management: Accurately track all prospect interactions, maintain clean data, and manage your pipeline efficiently within our CRM system. Feedback Loop: Provide valuable feedback to the marketing team regarding lead quality and market insights gathered from the front lines.

## Job Requirements
Experience: Previous experience in telesales, customer service, or a lead generation role is highly preferred. Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; you must have a strong, confident, and empathetic phone presence. Resilience: Ability to handle objections gracefully and maintain a positive attitude through rejection. Tech-Savvy: Experience using CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales engagement tools. Strategic Thinking: Ability to ask probing questions to uncover a prospect's true business pains and needs. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Number of Outbound Calls/Touches per day. Number of Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) generated per week/month. Number of meetings booked and successfully held by the sales team.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description_text:
## Job Description
Role Overview We are seeking a highly multitasking, honest, organized, reliable, and proactive professional to join our team as a Territory Manager. The ideal candidate must be able to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and take full ownership of responsibilities across sales, retail operations, client development, and reporting. This role requires strong leadership, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of performance and integrity. 1. Market Development & Client Acquisition Identify and develop potential clients and key accounts within the assigned territory. Prospect and approach corporate clients such as banks, financial institutions, and large companies for corporate gifting and partnership opportunities. Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with clients, partners, landlords, and stakeholders. Negotiate contracts, commercial agreements, and business partnerships. Develop and execute territory-specific sales strategies to drive revenue growth and brand expansion. Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities, including retail expansion and corporate sales channels. 2. Retail & Store Operations Oversee boutique setup and ensure full compliance with brand standards (layout, merchandising, customer experience, and visual identity). Manage daily store operations and ensure smooth workflow and efficiency. Coordinate and closely follow up with contractors, suppliers, and workers during boutique renovation and store setup projects. Monitor renovation progress to ensure timely execution, quality control, and compliance with deadlines and brand requirements. Search for suitable boutique locations and office spaces when required, and coordinate with landlords and real estate agents. Place product orders and ensure continuous stock availability across all boutiques. 3. Inventory & Stock Control Maintain accurate and updated inventory records across all locations. Manage stock movement, transfers, replenishment, and storage procedures. Conduct regular stock audits and ensure inventory accuracy at all times. Oversee stock management to prevent shortages, overstocking, and losses. Monitor inventory performance and ensure accurate reporting of stock levels. 4. Marketing & Brand Promotion Develop and implement marketing strategies across digital, social media, in-store, and event channels. Ensure consistent brand image and messaging across all customer touchpoints. Plan and execute promotional campaigns and local activations to increase visibility and sales. Support visual merchandising and in-store branding initiatives. Manage corporate gifting programs, including end-of-year gifts for banks, VIP clients, and institutional partners. Strengthen brand presence through strategic partnerships and client engagement activities. 5. Financial & Sales Management Monitor sales performance, revenue, and profitability across the territory. Prepare weekly and monthly sales, stock, and operational reports for management review. Analyze performance data and provide insights and recommendations for improvement. Manage budgets related to operations, marketing, boutique setup, and inventory procurement. Ensure sales targets and KPIs are achieved while maintaining cost efficiency and strong margins. Identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions when necessary. 6. Training & Team Coordination Participate in international training programs to align with global brand standards. Train and supervise store teams on product knowledge, customer service, and operational procedures. Ensure consistent service quality and operational excellence across all boutiques. Coordinate communication between stores and management to ensure smooth operations. Travel for meetings, training sessions, and coordination with headquarters or international partners when required. 7. Territory & Business Expansion Identify opportunities for new boutique openings and business growth. Search and evaluate potential boutique and office locations within the territory. Negotiate rental terms and coordinate with landlords and real estate agents. Support planning and execution of new store openings and renovation projects. Continuously improve store performance, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

## Job Requirements
Key Profile Requirements Highly multitasking, honest, and trustworthy individual. Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and negotiation abilities. Strong sense of responsibility, ownership, and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Experience in retail, sales, or business development is an advantage. Willingness to travel and work on-site when required.

title: Senior Business Development Manager (AI & Robotics) – EMEA, Remote
description_text:
## Job Description
About Pokamind Pokamind is an early-stage startup working at the intersection of AI and robotics. We're a small team building real products, not slide decks, and we're now at the point where we need someone who can go out and open doors for us across the EMEA region. You won't be handed a playbook and a warm pipeline. You'll help us build both. The role We're looking for a senior business developer who genuinely gets excited about AI and robotics and can translate that into real conversations with real people. Because we're a startup, the job is deliberately broad. On any given week you might be mapping out a market, writing outreach that doesn't sound like everyone else's, sitting on a call with a potential partner, or feeding what you hear back to the product team so we build the right thing. Concretely, you'll be: Finding and qualifying potential clients and partners across EMEA, and figuring out which ones are actually worth our time. Owning outreach end to end, from the first message to the signed agreement, including the marketing and positioning work that makes that outreach land. Building and nurturing partnerships, especially with people and organisations you already know or can reach through your network in the region. Negotiating and closing deals, then staying close enough to keep those relationships healthy. Working shoulder to shoulder with the founders on strategy, pricing, and where we point the company next. The role is fully remote. We care about what you deliver, not which chair you sit in. Who we think will do well here Honestly, the network matters. If you already have real relationships across EMEA in AI, robotics, industrial, or adjacent tech spaces, that's a huge part of what we're hiring for. Beyond that, we're looking for someone comfortable with the ambiguity of a startup, who can run without a manager standing over them, and who's just as happy writing a cold email as they are in a boardroom. If you've been the person who built a function from scratch before, you'll feel at home. What we offer A genuine seat at the table and real ownership of the commercial side of the business. The freedom to work how and where you work best. And the rare chance to shape a company in AI and robotics while it's still small enough that your decisions actually move the needle. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you, and we're especially interested in the specific EMEA relationships you'd bring with you.

## Job Requirements
6+ years in business development, sales, or partnerships, ideally some of it in a startup or early-stage environment. A real, active network across the EMEA region that you can put to work from day one. Genuine interest in AI and robotics, enough to hold your own in a technical conversation and speak credibly to prospects. A track record of finding, opening, and closing deals on your own, not just managing an inherited pipeline. Comfort wearing several hats: outreach, marketing, partnerships, negotiation, and market research. Strong written and spoken English; other EMEA languages are a real plus. Self-starter mindset. You're organised, you follow through, and you don't need to be managed closely. Happy working fully remote and across different time zones.

title: UI Web Developer
description_text:
## Job Description
Develop and maintain scalable, modular, and performance-optimized web frontend applications using Angular 20 (Standalone Components). Build reusable UI components, form-driven user interactions, dynamic tables, modals, and workflow-oriented screens for core business modules like ERP modules (Accounting, HR, Payments, and Reporting). Integrate RESTful APIs using Angular HttpClient and HTTP Interceptors for smooth data communication. Implement responsive, modern UI styling adhering to enterprise design standards using PrimeNG, Tailwind CSS, and SCSS. Manage application state, dynamic reactivity, and routing using RxJS, Signals, Services, and Angular Router with Lazy Loading and Route Guards. Collaborate within an Agile development environment to follow clean project structures, ensuring maintainability and continuous feature deployment. Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility while maintaining high performance and accessibility. Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and QA teams to troubleshoot issues, fix bugs, and improve existing features. Follow coding standards, best practices, and maintain technical documentation for frontend components.

## Job Requirements
Core Framework: Hands-on experience with Angular 20 (Standalone Components), TypeScript, Angular CLI, and Angular Router. UI & Styling Technologies: Proficiency in PrimeNG, PrimeIcons, Tailwind CSS, SCSS, Lucide Icons, and Font Awesome. Application & Reactive Logic: Strong expertise in Reactive Forms (FormGroup, FormControl), Dependency Injection (DI), Signals, Observables, Subjects, and Custom Validators. State & Data Management: Advanced skills in RxJS, Angular Signals, and Angular Services for state management. API & Security: Deep understanding of RESTful API integration using HttpClient, HTTP Interceptors, and API testing tools (Postman, Swagger). Architecture & Routing: solid knowledge of Modular Architecture, Lazy Loading, and Route Guards. Tools & Workflow: Proficiency with Git, GitHub, and Visual Studio Code within an Agile development workflow. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field. KeyWords: Angular 20 TypeScript Standalone Components PrimeNG Tailwind CSS RxJS Angular Signals Reactive Forms RESTful APIs HTTP Interceptors Lazy Loading Route Guards SCSS Git Agile ERP Development Modular Architecture Visual Studio Code Postman Swagger PrimeIcons Lucide Icons Font Awesome Angular CLI GitHub

description_text:
## Job Description
About LogiWorx: LogiWorx is a freight audit and logistics intelligence platform built for the Egyptian and regional Middle East market. We help shippers, freight forwarders, and manufacturers cut logistics costs and eliminate billing errors through proprietary, on-premise AI-powered auditing, combined with a CFO-backed compliance and tax advisory team. Our mission is to bring enterprise-grade cost visibility and control to logistics operations across the region. We're growing our commercial team and looking for a driven, relationship-oriented Sales Development Representative to lead outreach and build our pipeline of manufacturers, grain millers, distributors, and logistics-heavy enterprises across Egypt and the wider region. Role Summary: As a Sales Development Representative at LogiWorx, your job is to build our pipeline and get qualified conversations on the calendar. You will proactively reach out to prospective clients, run the initial pre-sales call yourself to introduce LogiWorx and qualify their fit, and then hand the opportunity off to the founder/product team for the full product demo and technical discussion. You will not run demos — your focus is outreach, first contact, and booking qualified calls. You'll work closely with the founder to refine target lists, messaging, and outreach strategy across Egypt and the wider region. What We Offer: Commission-based compensation tied to qualified calls booked and deals closed from your pipeline — earnings are performance-based, with no fixed salary. Opportunity to shape the sales function and go-to-market strategy at an early-stage, high-growth company. Direct access to and mentorship from the founding team. A product built specifically to solve real, high-value problems for regional logistics-heavy businesses. Key Responsibilities: Identify and prospect new business opportunities among shippers, freight forwarders, manufacturers, and distributors across Egypt and regional markets, through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, and other channels. Build and maintain a target account list, focusing on industries with heavy freight/logistics spend (e.g., grain milling, manufacturing, FMCG, distribution). Reach out directly to decision-makers (CFOs, supply chain directors, logistics managers) to introduce LogiWorx and generate interest. Conduct the initial pre-sales call with each prospect — introducing LogiWorx, understanding their logistics/freight audit needs, and qualifying whether they're a good fit. Book qualified demo calls onto the founder's/product team's calendar and hand off context clearly so the follow-up demo is well-prepared. Maintain accurate pipeline and activity records in the CRM; track outreach volume, response rates, and call-booking conversion. Follow up with prospects who haven't yet responded or scheduled a call, to keep the pipeline moving. Represent LogiWorx at regional trade shows, logistics industry events, and networking forums to generate leads. Gather market and prospect feedback from outreach and pre-sales calls to help refine messaging and targeting.

## Job Requirements
Required: 2+ years of experience in outbound sales, business development, or SDR/BDR roles, ideally in logistics, freight, SaaS, fintech, or enterprise software. Fluent in Arabic and English (spoken and written); comfortable cold calling and presenting in both. Proven track record of generating leads and booking qualified meetings/calls. Confident, articulate phone and video-call presence — comfortable running a first conversation with senior decision-makers (CFOs, supply chain directors). Strong understanding of, or ability to quickly learn, freight audit, logistics cost structures, and supply chain operations, to qualify prospects effectively. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills; persistent and organized in following up. Self-starter comfortable working in a small, fast-moving startup environment. Based in or willing to be based in Cairo.

title: Business Development Representative
description_text:
## Job Description
Business Development Representative (BDR) / Appointment Setter — US Market, Remote Company: RenoLens Location: Remote (Egypt-based, working US business hours) Type: Full-time, independent contractor Pay: Performance-based, per booked appointment plus close bonuses. Strong performers earn well above the local market (details below) About the Role RenoLens helps home service business owners in the United States (roofers, remodelers, and similar contractors) grow with a done-for-you marketing and automation system. We are hiring remote Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to call these business owners and book them onto our calendar for a product demo. As a BDR, you are not selling or closing. Your job is to have friendly, confident phone conversations, find owners who are a good fit, and book them for a demo. The owner runs the demo and closes the sale. Your success is measured by how many qualified appointments you book and how many of them show up. Everything runs through our calling system, which gives you the list, the script, and automatic call logging. You will always have people to call. What You Will Do Make outbound calls to US home service business owners from a prepared list Follow our proven script, then adapt naturally once you know it Identify decision makers and confirm they are a genuine fit Book qualified demo appointments onto the calendar Log clean notes after every call Show up consistently and hit weekly booking goals Pay This is a performance role with strong earning potential. You are paid for results, so the harder and smarter you work, the more you make. This is not a salaried desk job, and it is not for anyone looking to collect a paycheck for showing up. You earn for every qualified appointment that shows up, plus a bonus every time one of your booked demos becomes a paying client. There is no cap on how much you can earn. Top performers earn well above the local market , and the best callers make very good money here. There is real room to grow into more responsibility, higher pay, and referral bonuses for bringing in other strong callers. We are looking for people who back themselves and want their income tied to their results, not to a clock. How to Apply Apply here and we will follow up with a quick next step. Because this is a phone role, the most important part of your application is a short voice recording (about 60 seconds) telling us, in your own words, why you would be a great fit for this job. Speak naturally and confidently, the way you would on a real call. We hire based on how you sound and carry a conversation, so this recording matters more than your resume. We review recordings quickly and reach out to strong candidates within 48 hours.

## About the Role
RenoLens helps home service business owners in the United States (roofers, remodelers, and similar contractors) grow with a done-for-you marketing and automation system. We are hiring remote Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to call these business owners and book them onto our calendar for a product demo.
As a BDR, you are not selling or closing. Your job is to have friendly, confident phone conversations, find owners who are a good fit, and book them for a demo. The owner runs the demo and closes the sale. Your success is measured by how many qualified appointments you book and how many of them show up.
Everything runs through our calling system, which gives you the list, the script, and automatic call logging. You will always have people to call.

## Job Requirements
What We Are Looking For Clear, confident spoken English with a neutral or American-leaning accent. This is the single most important requirement. Our customers are US contractors, and they need to understand you easily and trust you quickly. Comfortable on the phone and not discouraged by rejection Reliable internet and a quiet place to call from Able to work US business hours. US daytime is evening and night in Egypt, so this is effectively a night shift. Please only apply if you can commit to this consistently. Previous cold calling, sales, or customer service experience is a plus but not required. Attitude and voice matter more than a resume.

Company Description El Nozha for Contracting specializes in delivering comprehensive construction and interior design solutions tailored to diverse client needs. The company provides end-to-end services, from new builds to complete interior redesigns, ensuring each project reflects the client's individual style and functional requirements. An experienced team combines local market knowledge with modern design principles to create high-quality, practical living and working spaces. With a strong focus on innovation and client satisfaction, El Nozha is dedicated to turning visions into reality with precision and reliability. Role Description The Site Engineer is a full-time, on-site role responsible for supervising and executing El Nozha's high-end finishing and fit-out projects across our sites in New Cairo/Madinaty and Port Said. This is a hands-on, ownership-driven position for an engineer who leads the work on the ground — managing labor, technicians, and subcontractors, enforcing quality on premium finishes, and keeping the project on schedule and within specification. Day-to-day, you will supervise all finishing works stages (plastering, tiling, marble and cladding, gypsum, painting, and coordination with MEP works); read and interpret architectural and shop drawings; verify quantities against the BOQ; monitor material deliveries and consumption; and maintain strict quality and safety standards that match a luxury standard of finishing. You will track daily progress, prepare site reports, coordinate closely with the technical office and management, and proactively flag any issues before they affect quality, cost, or timeline. This role demands presence, discipline, and accountability — the right engineer treats the site as their own and drives it to completion.

## Job Requirements
Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Civil or Architectural Engineering. 3–5 years of hands-on site experience, preferably in high-end finishing, fit-out, or luxury residential projects. Strong technical knowledge of finishing works stages and quality standards (plastering, tiling, marble/cladding, gypsum, painting, and MEP coordination). Ability to read and interpret architectural and shop drawings and to verify quantities against the BOQ. Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Office (especially Excel); familiarity with scheduling tools (Primavera P6 is a plus). Proven ability to lead and manage labor, technicians, and subcontractors on-site, and to enforce quality and safety standards. Strong organizational, reporting, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. title: QA Senior Engineer
description_text:
## Job Description
Core Responsibilities of the QA Senior Engineer 1. Integrated Management System (IMS) Governance and Compliance Implementing, maintaining, and continually improving the Integrated Management System (Quality, Environmental, and Occupational Health & Safety) in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 standards. Monitoring applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, client, and industry requirements (e.g., IMCA, API) and supporting their translation into controlled processes. Assisting in the establishment, deployment, and review of IMS policies, objectives, process ownership, and performance indicators across all departments and business lines. 2. Process Development and Documented Information Control Developing, reviewing, and improving policies, procedures, work instructions, forms, and process maps to ensure clear controls and acceptance criteria. Maintaining the controlled document structure and Master List of Documents, ensuring correct approval, revision, distribution, and withdrawal of obsolete documents. Reviewing document change requests for adequacy, compliance, and consistency with audit findings and current operations. 3. Internal and External Audit Management Supporting the preparation of the risk-based annual internal audit programme, including developing scopes, criteria, schedules, and checklists. Conducting or leading system, process, project, supplier, and operational audits, gathering objective evidence through interviews and document review. Documenting nonconformities, observations, and opportunities for improvement in clear and accurate audit reports. Coordinating certification, surveillance, client, and other external audits, preparing evidence and supporting responses to findings. 4. Operational, Project, and Supplier Quality Assurance Supporting project and offshore teams in preparing and reviewing quality plans, inspection requirements, and client-specific quality controls. Monitoring the implementation of approved processes through assurance activities and escalating significant quality risks or deviations. Supporting supplier qualification, selection, and performance evaluation, and following up on supplier corrective actions. 5. Nonconformity, CAPA, and Problem Solving Managing the lifecycle of nonconformities, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and customer complaints from registration through to closure. Facilitating structured root cause analysis using tools such as 5-Why, Fishbone, A3, or 8D to ensure systemic issues are addressed. Verifying the effectiveness and sustainability of completed corrective actions through evidence review and follow-up activities. 6. Risk-Based Thinking and Continual Improvement Facilitating process risk and opportunity assessments using tools like FMEA and risk matrices. Hands-on experience in internal/external audits, document control, nonconformity and CAPA management, customer complaints, supplier quality and process improvement. description_text:
## Job Description
About Us We are a small, agile, flat team where everyone's contribution directly impacts our success. We skip the corporate bureaucracy in favor of speed, collaboration, and high ownership. In this environment, you won't just be a cog in a machine—you will fully own your domain, work closely with everyone on the team, and have the autonomy to make things happen quickly for our customers. Location: New Cairo, 5th Settlement Role Summary The Customer Data Operations Specialist serves as the primary technical and operational bridge between our customers and our team and internal data systems. You will act as the dedicated custodian of customer data, managing system setups, executing complex data transformations, and ensuring all client requests are handled with absolute precision. This role requires a unique blend of advanced Excel wizardry, Business Intelligence (BI) proficiency, and exceptional client communication skills. If you thrive in a fast-paced, flat team environment where you can dive deep into data and manage client relationships, this role is for you. Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Management & Communication Act as the primary point of contact for dedicated customer system management and ongoing requests. Manage the client ticket queue from end to end: plan, execute, follow up, and officially respond to customers upon completion. Maintain clear, proactive communication with clients via text, email, and phone calls to clarify requirements and provide updates. 2. Data Operations & Excel Management Receive raw customer data (e.g., sales targets, pricing updates, salesperson-to-customer allocations) and utilize advanced Excel functions to clean, organize, and deduplicate it. Perform VLOOKUPs/XLOOKUPs and data mapping to align client data with internal system codes, ensuring it is perfectly formatted and loadable. Lead critical, high-impact data events including year-start system setups , price updates, target adjustments, and exchange rate configurations. 3. System Administration, BI, & Ad-Hoc Analysis Build, configure, and maintain customer data structures within the core system. Act as a BI Super User , leveraging BI tools to analyze data trends, validate system outputs, and make minor configuration changes or reports as needed. Fulfill ad-hoc data and analysis requests: Quickly generate custom data pulls, ad-hoc reports, and deep-dive analyses to help answer specific customer business questions. Collaborate with internal Data Specialists to coordinate large-scale system changes, while remaining hands-on with daily data tasks. 4. Quality Assurance & Documentation Own the Quality Assurance (QA) process: thoroughly check, review, and test all data uploads, custom reports, and system changes to ensure zero errors before client delivery. Document everything: Create and maintain meticulous logs of all system builds, ongoing changes, process workflows, and incidents.

## Job Requirements
Skills & Qualifications Required Technical Skills Advanced Excel Skills (Must-Have): Mastery of complex formulas (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, IF statements), Power Query, Pivot Tables, and data cleaning techniques. BI Super User: Experience navigating and utilizing Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar) with the ability to perform basic modifications and analysis. Ad-Hoc Reporting: Strong ability to query data, synthesize findings quickly, and package ad-hoc requests into clear, actionable formats for customers. Data Integrity Focus: Strong background in handling sensitive data sets like pricing, targets, and customer-salesperson allocations. Soft Skills & Experience Client-Facing Experience: Proven track record in customer service, account management, or technical support. Excellent Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills across email, chat, and phone. High Attention to Detail: A natural instinct to double-check work, spot anomalies in large data sets, and prioritize quality assurance. Agility & Organization: Ability to balance structured daily ticket queues with urgent, unpredictable ad-hoc data requests.

Processing & Streaming: Spark (internals, tuning), Kafka / Structured Streaming, dbt (enterprise patterns). Architecture: Lakehouse (Delta/Iceberg), Data Mesh, Lambda/Kappa. Governance & Quality: catalogs, lineage, RBAC/masking, data contracts, observability. Infrastructure & DevOps: advanced Terraform, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes. Emerging: feature stores, vector databases, LLM/RAG data pipelines. Your Responsibilities Own architecture on engagements; act as the Design Authority. Solve the hardest problems: streaming under load, Spark debugging, framework design. Drive presales: assessments, audits, estimations; explain the ROI of modernization. Make solutions production-ready: secure, observable, cost-efficient, documented - with quality SLAs defined. Set standards, review code, grow Middle and Junior engineers. What We Offer Long-term career stability with a competitive salary paid in USD. Conditions for steady career development. Development supported by dedicated mentors and a variety of programs focused on expertise and innovation. Private medical insurance provided after successful completion of the probationary period A well-equipped and cozy office supports comfort and productivity across all project stages. Welcoming atmosphere and a friendly corporate culture.

Your Skills Experience: 5+ years of data engineering, with delivery you owned end to end. Engineering Mastery: expert Python and SQL; you optimize code others wrote. Platform Depth: Databricks (Spark memory, partitioning) or Snowflake (warehouse tuning, RBAC, zero-copy cloning) - how they work under the hood. title: Data Protection Officer(DPO)
description_text:
## Job Description
Ensure organization-wide compliance with PDPL No. 151 of 2020, its Executive Regulations, and PDPC decisions, circulars, and licensing conditions. Establish, maintain, and periodically review the personal data protection framework, including policies, standards, and procedures covering collection, processing, storage, disclosure, and destruction of personal data. Maintain a comprehensive and up-to-date Record of Processing Activities (RoPA) describing all personal data processing operations, legal bases, retention periods, and security measures. Manage the organization's licenses, permits, and accreditations required from the PDPC, including those for processing sensitive personal data, electronic marketing, and cross-border data transfers. Verify the validity and lawfulness of data processing systems and conduct periodic evaluations and audits of their effectiveness, documenting and reporting the results. Establish and operate procedures for receiving, verifying, and responding to data subject requests (access, correction, erasure, objection, withdrawal of consent) within the timelines prescribed by the PDPL and its Executive Regulations. Ensure that valid, informed, and documented consent is obtained where required as the legal basis for processing, and that consent withdrawal mechanisms are available. Handle and resolve complaints submitted by data subjects and maintain a register of complaints and their outcomes. Act as the official liaison and point of contact with the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Centre, including registration, correspondence, inspections, and requests for information. Deliver ongoing data protection training and awareness programs for employees and management. Report periodically to executive management and relevant governance committees on the organization's data protection posture, compliance gaps, incidents, and remediation plans. Monitor legal and regulatory developments (PDPL Executive Regulations, PDPC guidance, sectoral requirements from CBE, NTRA, FRA, etc.) and advise on their impact.

## Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Law, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification in data protection, cybersecurity, or compliance is an advantage. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in data protection, privacy compliance, information security governance, or regulatory compliance, with at least 2 years in a privacy-focused role. Demonstrable knowledge of Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 and its Executive Regulations, and familiarity with international frameworks such as the EU GDPR for benchmarking purposes. Experience dealing with regulators; prior interaction with Egyptian regulatory bodies is a strong advantage. Recognized privacy/security certifications preferred: CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT (IAPP), CDPSE (ISACA), CISM, CISSP, or ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer. Fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken) is required, given bilingual regulatory correspondence and documentation.

title: Master Data Management Specialist (MDM Specialist)
description_text:
## Job Description
About the Role: We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Master Data Management Specialist to join our Supply Chain team. This role will be responsible for managing, validating, and maintaining accurate master data within our ERP system, ensuring data integrity across the organization and supporting ERP implementation and upgrades. Key Responsibilities: Implement and maintain company-wide item coding structures in alignment with ERP and business rules. Lead and coordinate with all departments to complete ERP master data templates (items, suppliers, customers, BOMs where applicable). Validate all submitted templates for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with coding standards. Perform regular data cleansing and ensure non-duplication of data using validation rules and logic. Maintain and update ERP master data including: Supplier Register Customer Master Item Master List Other master data domains as required Control master data change requests and approvals according to the authority matrix. Support ERP implementation and upgrades from a data perspective. Coordinate with the IT ERP team on master data structure and migration. Train end-users on data entry guidelines and standards. Ensure compliance with internal controls and audit requirements.

## Job Requirements
Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related field. 3–5 years of experience in ERP master data management, preferably within supply chain environments. Hands-on experience with Oracle ERP is preferred. Exposure to manufacturing, logistics, industrial, or trading companies is an advantage. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of ERP master data domains: Item, Supplier, and Customer Masters. Experience with ERP master data templates and data cleansing. Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, duplicates detection). Understanding of item classification logic, units of measure, product hierarchy, and item attributes (procurement, inventory, costing). Personal Skills: Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Analytical, structured, and process-oriented thinker. Strong documentation discipline. Excellent communication and coordination skills. Ability to work cross-functionally across all departments. High integrity and respect for confidentiality.

title: Structural Engineer – Remote Position
description_text:

Strong written and verbal English communication skills are mandatory. Ability to understand technical instructions and communicate engineering information clearly in English. Ability to write clear, professional, and grammatically correct emails. Strong attention to detail, organization, and time-management skills. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional home-working setup. Ability to maintain reasonable overlap with Canadian working hours when required. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience working remotely with an international engineering company. Experience with residential and light-commercial projects. Familiarity with North American or Canadian structural design practices and building codes. Experience with concrete, steel, masonry, and wood structures. Experience preparing calculation packages and structural drawing markups.

title: Senior Web Developer
description_text:
## Job Description
Software Development: Design, develop, and maintain modern .NET web applications with relational database backends, leveraging Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and robust DBMS principles. System Maintenance: Enhance and support existing legacy systems (including classic ASP.NET applications) alongside new greenfield development, ensuring compliance with approved technologies and coding standards. Collaboration & Mentorship: Work effectively with team members on multi-person projects. Conduct thorough code reviews, enforce best practices, and actively share knowledge across the engineering team. Documentation: Create comprehensive system documentation, API schemas, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for enterprise application development.

## Job Requirements
Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or an equivalent discipline. 3+ years of professional work experience as a .NET Developer , with a heavy emphasis on modern .NET ecosystems. Core Technical Skills Backend & Frameworks: Proficient in C# and modern .NET Core / .NET 6+ (Web API, Minimal APIs). Solid working knowledge of legacy ASP.NET MVC to maintain and migrate older systems. AI & Machine Learning Integration: Practical experience implementing AI inference within applications. This includes: Consuming LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Google AI/Gemini ). Working with local LLM runtimes and orchestration tools (e.g., Ollama, vLLM ). Deploying and running optimized models using ONNX Runtime . Data & ORM: Deep knowledge of Entity Framework Core (EF Core) and SQL Server (MSSQL) database development, including relational database design, query optimization, and indexing. Frontend Web Technologies: Good working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery, AJAX, and standard data-interchange formats (JSON, XML). System Deployment : Hands-on experience managing and deploying applications on Windows Server (IIS) and Linux environments. Understanding of Docker for containerization is a plus. Architecture & Software Engineering Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) ,SOLID principles, and Web Security (JWT, OAuth2). Hands-on experience implementing architectural design patterns, specifically the Repository Pattern and Unit of Work Pattern , with a proven ability to write reusable libraries. ## Job Description
The Senior Full-Stack Developer is responsible for the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of ITIDA's customer-facing digital products. This includes public-facing websites, external service portals, API integrations, and any digital interface that connects ITIDA with its external stakeholders including registered companies, technology investors, program applicants, and the general public. This role operates within the Digital Transformation scope under the direct supervision of the IT Manager, and works in close coordination with the Internal Applications team. The position is expected to function with a high degree of autonomy, taking end-to-end ownership of external digital products from requirements gathering through to production and maintenance. 1  External Web & Portal Development •      Design, develop, and maintain ITIDA's public-facing websites, service portals, and digital platforms. •      Build responsive, accessible, and performant front-end interfaces aligned with ITIDA's brand identity and UX standards. •      Develop robust back-end services, RESTful APIs, and integrations with third-party systems and government platforms. •      Ensure all external-facing applications meet web security standards (OWASP Top 10) and performance benchmarks. 2  API Development & Integration •      Design and expose secure REST/GraphQL APIs consumed by external partners, mobile applications, and third-party integrations. •      Integrate with external government systems, payment gateways, identity verification services, and data providers as required. •      Document all APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger standards and maintain up-to-date technical documentation. 3  Architecture & Technical Quality •      Contribute to the selection of frameworks, tools, and hosting architectures for external applications. •      Enforce coding standards, conduct code reviews, and maintain a clean, maintainable codebase. •      Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) for all external products. •      Monitor application health, performance, and uptime using appropriate observability tools; respond to incidents. 4  Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement •      Translate business and departmental requirements into clear technical specifications and deliver against agreed timelines. •      Work closely with the Business Analyst on requirements documentation, gap analysis, and SLA definitions. •      Coordinate with the Internal Applications team to ensure consistency in shared components, design systems, and data contracts. •      Liaise with external vendors, hosting providers, and technology partners as needed. 5  Security, Compliance & Governance •      Ensure all external applications comply with EGCert Security requirements applicable to public-facing services. •      Apply security best practices across the full stack: input validation, authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging. •      Participate in periodic security assessments and penetration testing cycles; remediate identified vulnerabilities within agreed SLAs.

## Job Requirements
1 Education •      Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field. •      A relevant postgraduate qualification or professional certifications are a plus. 2  Experience •      5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development, with a strong portfolio of external-facing digital products. •      Demonstrated experience owning the full development lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. •      Prior experience in a government agency, public sector digital services, or regulated environment is an advantage. 3  Technical Skills — Front-End •      Proficiency in one or more modern JavaScript frameworks: React.js, Vue.js, or Angular. •      Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design principles, and accessibility standards. •      Familiarity with component libraries and design systems. 4  Technical Skills — Back-End •      Proficiency in one or more server-side languages/frameworks: Node.js (Express/NestJS), Python (Django/FastAPI), PHP (Laravel), or Java (Spring Boot). •      Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs; GraphQL experience is a plus. •      Solid understanding of authentication and authorization patterns: OAuth 2.0, JWT, OpenID Connect. •      Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and basic query optimization. 5  DevOps & Infrastructure •      Experience with cloud platforms — Microsoft Azure preferred (aligns with ITIDA's existing M365/Azure environment); AWS or GCP also acceptable. •      Practical knowledge of containerization (Docker) and orchestration concepts (Kubernetes is a plus). •      Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent. •      Understanding of DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN configuration, and web hosting management. 6  Soft Skills •      Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Arabic and English. •      Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables with minimal supervision. •      Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset; comfortable with ambiguity in early-stage projects. •      Collaborative team player with experience working alongside non-technical stakeholders.

description_text:
## Job Description
Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using both front-end and back-end technologies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features. Experience with version control systems such as Git. Ability to work independently and efficiently in a home-based environment. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Strong communication and collaboration abilities. Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is a plus. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks. Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide junior team members.

وصف الوظيفة
We’re hiring a Senior Product Owner to own end-to-end product execution and delivery discipline. This is a tactical, execution-focused role for someone who can translate product strategy into developer-ready Jira work and maximize value delivered sprint after sprint.
You will be the single source of truth for your team’s work, owning the backlog, leading a strong Agile cadence, and ensuring predictable delivery across web and mobile.
The Mission
Bring clarity, speed, and predictability to product delivery by:
Turning business requirements into high-quality Epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases
Running a strong sprint cadence and driving accountability
Reducing rework, reducing cycle time, and improving sprint predictability
Owning Jira as the source of truth, workflows, dashboards, releases, reporting
What You’ll Own
1) Backlog ownership and requirements clarity
Own and prioritize the product backlog, keep the team focused on highest-value work
Translate high-level requirements into detailed, actionable user stories with testable acceptance criteria
Capture edge cases, failure states, and clear “what done means”
2) Agile execution and delivery discipline
Lead grooming, sprint planning, daily follow-ups, sprint reviews, and retros
Drive dependencies and unblock engineers fast, across backend, web, iOS, Android, DevOps
Enforce Definition of Ready and Definition of Done
Protect sprint scope, manage change requests, enforce tradeoffs
3) Jira ownership
Workflows, boards, components, priorities, versions/releases, dashboards
Weekly reporting and visibility into progress, blockers, and next sprint readiness
4) Release management and quality
Coordinate releases across Web, iOS, Android, including versioning and release notes
Own release readiness checklist, staging readiness, smoke testing coordination
Coordinate UAT for major features, validate readiness, accept stories as done
5) Product documentation and decision log
Maintain lightweight PRDs/feature briefs, a decision log, and onboarding docs
Ensure specs and Jira stay aligned, one reliable reference
6) Analytics instrumentation requirements
Define tracking requirements for key flows and ensure they are included in acceptance criteria when relevant
Work with engineers to confirm instrumentation is implemented consistently
7) Customer feedback loop
Own intake and triage for customer and seller feedback
Convert recurring issues into prioritized fixes, bugs, and improvements
Run a weekly “top issues” review and drive closure visibility
What Success Looks Like (measurable)
Cycle time goes down (created to done)
Rework goes down (clearer requirements, fewer misunderstandings)
Sprint predictability improves (commit vs delivered)
Releases become smoother, fewer production issues
Jira becomes trusted, clean, and scalable
Product decisions and behavior are documented clearly
Feedback loop turns support pain into shipped fixes
Key flows have proper tracking so we can iterate with data
متطلبات الوظيفة
Must-have
5+ years in Product Owner, Delivery, Product Ops, Technical PM roles in software teams
Strong user story writing, acceptance criteria, edge case thinking
Hands-on Jira mastery, workflows, dashboards, releases/versions, not just user-level
Proven delivery ownership, you improved throughput, predictability, or quality in past roles
Technical fluency, comfortable discussing APIs, dependencies, tradeoffs with engineers
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and without an Engineering Manager
Nice-to-have
Marketplace, e-commerce, payments, logistics, disputes/returns, KYC experience
Mobile release experience (App Store, Play Store)
Live streaming/video product experience
CSPO or similar certification is a plus

title: Senior Product Owner
description_text:
## Job Description
About the Job: We are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Owner to join our team at H.Q. and drive the success of our governmental software projects! If you have a knack for bridging the gap between technical teams and government stakeholders, we want to hear from you. Key Responsibilities: Product Vision & Roadmap: Define product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities, ensuring alignment with governmental regulations and strategic objectives. Requirements & Backlog Management: Write User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, BRDs (Business Requirement Documents), and manage the solution features backlog. UX Collaboration: Collaborate with the UX team to ensure the UX design aligns completely with the documented business requirements. Team Support: Support developers and QC engineers by clarifying requirements or business concerns raised anytime within the development lifecycle. Stakeholder Management: Negotiate priorities, scope, funding, and schedule. Demonstrate to stakeholders the solution scope, business value, solution design, requirements, and identified risks. Impact: Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the public sector.

## Job Requirements
Required Qualifications: Governmental Sector (MUST): Solid experience implementing and delivering governmental software projects is an absolute MUST . Experience: 2 - 3 years of proven experience as a Product Owner or similar role in software development. Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. SDLC Knowledge: Excellent, deep knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC). Tools: Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Visio, Agile/Scrum Frameworks (e.g., Jira/Trello), and wireframing tools. Languages: Fluent in English with excellent writing/editing and verbal communication skills. Key Skills: Strong analytical, organizational, multitasking, and stress-management skills with the ability to establish a high level of customer trust and confidence.

description_text:

title: Senior - Staff IOS Native Software Engineer
description_text:
## Job Description
About ExpiWell ExpiWell is a mobile platform built for experience sampling and ecological momentary assessment (EMA) research. We help researchers and clinicians collect real-time data from participants in their daily lives through intuitive mobile experiences and survey tools. About the Role We are seeking a Senior / Staff iOS Native Software Engineer to own the technical direction, system design, and long-term evolution of the ExpiWell mobile ecosystem. This is a high-level engineering role requiring deep, battle-tested expertise in native Apple ecosystems. This is not a generalist web or frontend JavaScript role. Our core platform is a native iOS application, and your foundational engineering strength must be rooted deeply in native Apple frameworks. However, because we are driving our transition toward a unified mobile platform, architectural experience with React Native and the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem is a strict requirement. You will be the bridge that ensures our native infrastructure integrates seamlessly with our cross-platform future while adhering to rigorous clinical data standards. Our Current Codebase & Tech Stack To give you an exact picture of what you will be stepping into, our repository and architecture primarily center around: Swift: Modern native core implementation, native modules, and platform architecture. Apple Frameworks & Kits: Deep application of HealthKit , SensorKit , CoreLocation , and CoreMotion for participant telemetry and health metrics collection. JavaScript / TypeScript: React Native expansion for shared business logic and cross-platform feature parity. What You'll Do Architectural Leadership: Own the overarching architecture, design patterns, and technical roadmap for our production iOS (Swift) and React Native applications. Biometric & Biomechanic Telemetry: Design and optimize data collection services that query and process passive/active research metrics using HealthKit and SensorKit . Core Mobile Telemetry: Optimize hardware-level native services including location monitoring ( CoreLocation ) and motion processing frameworks ( CoreMotion ) for geofencing and location-based survey triggers. Data Strategy & Privacy: Architect bulletproof offline-first data persistence layers using CoreData and Secure Keychain, adhering strictly to global compliance baselines ( HIPAA , GDPR , and SOC 2 ). Bridge Architecture: Write high-performance native bridging modules to connect native iOS Swift logic with our React Native and JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems. Legacy Modernization: Strategize and execute the incremental refactoring, modularization, and modernization of our legacy native codebases without interrupting active clinical research studies. Release & Infrastructure Ownership: Direct the entire App Store submission pipeline, provisioning profiles, CocoaPods dependency management, and automated Xcode deployment infrastructure. Required Qualifications Expert-Level Native iOS Mastery: Deep professional experience in native iOS application development with a proven track record operating at a Senior, Lead, or Staff level. Framework Expertise: Complete mastery of UIKit, Storyboards, Auto Layout, CoreLocation, CoreData, HealthKit, and SensorKit . Compliance & Security Rigor: Solid understanding of building apps that strictly comply with HIPAA, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type 2 guidelines (end-to-end encryption at rest and in transit, access control enforcement, and audit logs). Cross-Platform Competency: Production-grade architecture experience using JavaScript/TypeScript and React Native to build cross-platform feature parity. Language Proficiency: Advanced command of Swift and modern native iOS architectures. App Store Pedigree: Complete history of deploying, configuring, and maintaining highly rated commercial apps directly on the Apple App Store. Why ExpiWell Drive the technical vision for technology used globally in critical behavioral and health research. Collaborative, research-driven engineering team environment with high technical autonomy. Flexible, fully remote working structure within Bangladesh. Competitive monthly salary package aligned with the absolute top tier of local senior standards. Opportunity to serve as the ultimate technical authority and shape our mobile architecture. Job Type: Full-time Work Location: Remote

## Job Requirements
Preferred Qualifications Experience designing flexible engines for complex dynamic forms, custom survey validation logic, or matrix questions. Engineering background in health-tech, remote patient monitoring (RPM), or data-intensive research applications. Experience building and scaling custom automated build pipelines (Fastlane, Xcode Cloud). Understanding of broader cross-platform ecosystems, including Android execution environments. Core Tech Stack (iOS Native First) Primary Native Language: Swift Location & Contextual Tracking: CoreLocation, Geolocation, Geofencing, CoreMotion Push Notifications & Cloud Integration: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM Notifications) Native Apple Frameworks & Kits: HealthKit, SensorKit, CoreData, UIKit, Storyboards, Auto Layout, Secure Keychain Cross-Platform Integration (Bridge): React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript (used strictly for shared business logic and cross-platform feature parity) Compliance, Security & Vulnerability Management: Security Pentesting, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2 Type 2 compliant data pipelines and encrypted local storage Dependency Management & DevOps: Swift Package Manager (SPM), CocoaPods, Fastlane, Xcode Cloud

title: QA / Software Test Engineer (AI-Augmented Testing)
description_text:
## Job Description
We're looking for a Software Test Engineer with around 2 years of experience who combines solid testing fundamentals with curiosity about using AI to make testing faster and more reliable. You'll help ensure the quality of our products by designing and running tests, building automation, and applying AI tools to generate tests, analyze failures, and cut down on manual effort. This is a great fit for someone early in their QA career who wants to grow while working with modern, AI-assisted testing practices. What You'll Do - Write and maintain test cases and automated tests across web, API, and/or mobile. - Use AI-assisted tools to help generate test cases, create test data, and expand coverage from user stories or requirements. - Build and maintain automated tests (UI, API, regression) and help keep them running in CI/CD pipelines. - Use AI to speed up failure triage — grouping similar failures and flagging flaky tests. - Work with self-healing automation and AI-driven locators to reduce test maintenance. - Perform functional, regression, and exploratory testing. - Review AI-generated tests and output critically — checking correctness and removing noise rather than trusting it blindly. - Track, document, and clearly report bugs, and work with developers to get them resolved. - Learn and experiment with new AI testing tools, and share what works with the team.

## Job Requirements
- Around 2 years (roughly 1–3) of experience in software testing or QA. - Good understanding of testing fundamentals: test case design, regression, the test pyramid, and the bug life cycle. - Experience writing automated tests with a framework such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium. - Basic-to-intermediate scripting ability in at least one language (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#). - Some hands-on experience using AI tools in a development or testing workflow (e.g., LLM-based assistants or AI test generators) — or clear enthusiasm to learn. - Experience testing APIs (REST) with a tool like Postman. - Familiarity with version control (Git) and basic CI/CD concepts. - Attention to detail and the judgment to question results — including AI output that looks wrong. - Clear written and verbal communication. Nice to Have - Exposure to AI-powered or self-healing testing platforms. - Some prompt engineering experience for generating tests, test data, or documentation. - Basic knowledge of performance testing (JMeter, k6) or security testing. - Curiosity about testing AI/ML features (validating model outputs, prompt regression, hallucination or safety checks). - Familiarity with Docker or cloud test environments. - ISTQB Foundation (or similar) certification. How We Use AI in Testing (so you know what to expect) - *Test generation:* turning requirements and code into draft test cases and data. - *Maintenance:* self-healing locators and AI suggestions to cut down on broken tests. - *Analysis:* automatic failure grouping, flaky-test detection, and prioritizing what to fix first. - *Productivity:* AI assistants for writing scripts, documentation, and bug reports — always with human review. We treat AI as a helper, not a replacement for engineering judgment. You'll always be expected to check and own the quality of what ships. What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months) - Ramped up on our products, test suites, and CI/CD pipeline. - Contributing reliable automated tests and helping reduce manual regression effort. - Using AI tools to speed up test creation or failure triage in a measurable way. - Working well with developers to help ship high-quality releases.

If your focus is statistics, model training, or data analysis rather than building software, this role isn’t the right fit. Use modern AI development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor as part of your daily engineering workflow — for research, prototyping, code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, and documentation. Integrate AI capabilities into real products, including LLM APIs, retrieval-based systems, RAG, and agent/tool workflows. Review AI-generated code critically. Make sure it is reliable, maintainable, secure, and consistent with the team’s engineering standards. Take part in architecture discussions, technical design, and code reviews. Help define reusable patterns and practical team practices for working with AI. Work closely with engineering, product, delivery, and customer-facing teams. Understand not only what needs to be built, but also why it matters for the business. Stay flexible with the stack. Strengthen your backend expertise while growing into frontend and cloud areas when the project requires it. What we offer Stable long-term cooperation and competitive compensation. The chance to work at the cutting edge of agentic AI development on international projects. A fast and well-structured onboarding process with a dedicated mentor. A clear career development path and access to learning programs. Paid vacation, national public holidays, and support during religious celebrations. A modern and comfortable office based in Smart Village, at the heart of Cairo’s tech ecosystem. Healthy work–life balance. A welcoming corporate culture, team support, and respectful communication.

## Job Requirements
What we expect from you 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, building web/product applications. Strong command of at least one backend language: Node.js, TypeScript, Python, PHP, .NET / C#, or Java . Solid full-stack fundamentals — comfortable working across APIs, databases, and deployment, not just a single layer. Hands-on experience using AI-assisted / agentic engineering tools in real delivery work (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Copilot CLI, or similar). We mean confident, fluent use — these tools are already a routine part of how you build and ship, not something you’ve only tried a few times. Demonstrable experience with several of: prompt engineering for development workflows, multi-step agentic development, AI-assisted debugging and refactoring, AI-assisted test generation, and rapid prototyping with AI. The judgment to use AI responsibly — understanding the limitations, risks, and governance considerations of AI-generated code. A genuine readiness to learn and work in the front-end (any modern framework) when the work calls for it. Front-end experience is not required, but the right mindset is. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and drive work to production with little supervision. Upper-Intermediate English level (B2). A proactive mindset, good communication, and the ability to thrive in a high-impact, fast-paced environment. Will be a plus Front-end experience with a modern framework (React / Angular / Vue) and TypeScript. Cloud fundamentals with one of the major platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP). Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Kubernetes. Knowledge of message brokers (Kafka / RabbitMQ) and observability (ELK / Prometheus & Grafana). Experience embedding AI/LLM features into products: RAG pipelines, vector databases (Pinecone / Qdrant), embeddings, and semantic search. Experience building MCP servers/tools, custom “agent skills,” or multi-agent orchestration (e.g., LangChain / LangGraph). Experience running self-hosted or local models (Ollama, vLLM). Awareness of secure, governed use of AI in enterprise development environments (e.g., preventing data/PII leakage).

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (IT / Software)

title: Software Sales Specialist
description_text:
## Job Description
About Us: Simple Touch Software specializes in providing comprehensive ERP management solutions tailored for restaurants and cafes in the F&B local chains business. Our software covers all processes from raw material purchasing to inventory management, ensuring streamlined operations and enhanced efficiency for our clients. Job Description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Software Sales Representative to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software sales, specifically within the F&B industry, and a proven track record of achieving sales targets. As a Senior Software Sales Representative, you will be responsible for driving sales, building and maintaining client relationships, and identifying new business opportunities. Responsibilities: Sales Strategy Development : Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve company sales targets and expand our customer base. This includes setting short-term and long-term goals, identifying key market segments, and creating targeted approaches for each segment. Lead Generation : Identify and qualify new business opportunities through various channels including cold calling, networking, referrals, and participation in industry events and trade shows. Client Engagement : Conduct product demonstrations and presentations to prospective clients, showcasing the features and benefits of Simple Touch Software. This involves understanding client needs, tailoring presentations to address specific pain points, and effectively communicating the value proposition. Relationship Management : Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships by understanding their needs and providing tailored solutions. Act as the primary point of contact for key clients, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty. Collaboration : Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute promotional campaigns and with the product development team to provide customer feedback and influence product enhancements. Ensure alignment in sales strategies and product offerings to meet market demands. Sales Negotiation : Negotiate and close sales agreements, ensuring mutually beneficial terms for both the client and Simple Touch Software. Manage contract negotiations, pricing discussions, and terms of service agreements. Sales Reporting : Provide accurate sales forecasts and reports to the management team. Track sales activities, pipeline status, and key performance metrics using CRM software. Market Analysis : Stay up-to-date with industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities. Conduct market research to identify emerging opportunities and threats. Mentorship : Mentor and guide junior sales team members, sharing best practices and providing support to help them achieve their targets.

## Job Requirements
Job Requirements: Education : Bachelor’s degree in Software, Business, Marketing, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus. Experience : Minimum of 5 years of experience in software sales, preferably within the F&B industry. Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding sales targets. Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of ERP software and its applications in the F&B industry. Familiarity with the technical aspects of software deployment and integration. Sales Skills : Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear and compelling manner. Customer Focus : Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients at all levels. Strong customer service orientation with a commitment to customer satisfaction. Self-Motivation : Highly self-motivated with a results-driven approach. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team. Technology Proficiency : Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Zoho CRM, Salesforce) and MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Ability to quickly learn new software tools and systems. Flexibility : Willingness to travel as needed to meet clients and attend industry events. What We Offer: Compensation : Competitive salary and commission structure, designed to reward high performers. Benefits : Comprehensive health insurance and benefits package, including dental and vision coverage. Professional Development : Opportunities for professional development and career growth. Access to training programs, industry conferences, and educational resources. Work Environment : Supportive and dynamic work environment with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Regular team-building activities and social events. Flexibility : Flexible work arrangements, including remote work options.

Unleash Your Leadership in Software Quality! Are you a seasoned quality assurance professional ready to lead a dynamic team in shaping the future of software?
